Show progress as a growing plant

Source: R/plant_growth.R
plant_growth.Rd

Draws a potted plant whose growth follows a level between 0 and 1. The plant goes through stages: a seed, a sprout, a stem with leaves, a bud (from 55 percent) and a flower that opens fully at 100 percent. It sways gently in the breeze. When the chart scrolls into view, the plant grows from the seed to the level while the percentage counts up and the stage is written below it.

Usage

plant_growth(
  fill_level = 0.5,
  potWidth = NULL,
  potHeight = NULL,
  plantMaxHeight = NULL,
  stemColor = "#3ca951",
  potColor = "#c96f45",
  flowerColor = "#ff8ab7",
  strokeColor = NULL,
  strokeWidth = 1.5,
  renderFillLabel = TRUE,
  titleText = "Plant growth",
  titleColor = "#333",
  titleFontSize = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  labelColor = "#333",
  labelFontSize = NULL,
  soilColor = "#5b3a29",
  target = NULL,
  sway = TRUE,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bgcol = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how grown the plant is (values outside are clamped). Defaults to 0.5.

potWidth

Optional. The width of the pot in pixels. By default it depends on the size of the chart.

potHeight

Optional. The height of the pot in pixels.

plantMaxHeight

Optional. The height of the fully grown plant (above the soil) in pixels. By default the plant uses the height available.

stemColor

The colour of the stem and the leaves. Defaults to "#3ca951".

potColor

The colour of the pot. Defaults to "#c96f45".

flowerColor

The colour of the petals of the bud and the flower. Defaults to "#ff8ab7".

strokeColor

Optional. The outline colour of the pot. Defaults to a darker shade of potColor.

strokeWidth

The outline width of the pot. Defaults to 1.5.

renderFillLabel

Logical. Show the percentage and the stage above the plant. Defaults to TRUE.

titleText

Optional. A caption below the pot. Defaults to "Plant growth"; use NULL to hide it.

titleColor

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

titleFontSize

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

labelColor

The colour of the percentage and the target label. Defaults to "#333".

labelFontSize

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it depends on the size of the chart.

soilColor

The colour of the soil. Defaults to "#5b3a29".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1 marked with a dashed line at the corresponding height.

sway

Logical. Let the plant sway in the breeze. Defaults to TRUE.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Grow the plant from the seed when it first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bgcol

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Hover the plant: the breeze picks up and the leaves flutter.

  • Click the plant: a watering can waters it and the plant perks up.

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag up or down on the plant to set the level, or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the plant sets input$id_clicked to a list with value and stage, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the plant grows (or shrinks) from the old level to the new one.

Examples

plant_growth(0.4)


plant_growth(1, titleText = "Project completed")


plant_growth(
  0.7,
  target = 0.9,
  potColor = "#4269d0",
  flowerColor = "#efb118",
  draggable = TRUE
)
